n: Machine Learning and Image Recognition: A Powerful Duo
t: A 45 minute Purdue 4-H lesson that sorts plant cards to model image recognition.
steps: Find the Purdue 4-H lesson Machine Learning and Image Recognition.
Print and cut one set of image cards for each group.
Print one plant identification sheet for each group.
Divide students into groups of 2 to 4.
Read the page of discussion questions for the wrap-up.
